diagnosisRequirements.description: Moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis
diagnosisRequirements.evidenceText: Diagnosis of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis confirmed by appropriate diagnostic criteria and clinical assessment.

source.document: UHC Commercial Medical Policy - TNF Inhibitors

stepTherapy.failureCriteria: inadequate response, contraindication, or documented intolerance
stepTherapy.evidenceText: History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to a 3-month trial of methotrexate or other conventional disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (DMARD) at maximally indicated doses is required prior to initiating TNF inhibitor therapy.

source.document: UHC Commercial Medical Policy - TNF Inhibitors

otherRequirements.requirement: Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Prescription must be written by or in consultation with a rheumatologist with expertise in treating rheumatoid arthritis.

source.document: UHC Commercial Medical Policy - TNF Inhibitors

otherRequirements.requirement: Not used in combination with other biologic DMARDs or JAK inhibitors
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Etanercept must not be used in combination with other biologic DMARDs or targeted synthetic DMARDs (e.g., JAK inhibitors) for the same indication due to increased infection risk without demonstrated clinical benefit.
